questions.question: What percentage of the total Union Budget does the Defence Budget constitute for the Financial Year 2024-25?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**13.04%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Defence Budget for the Financial Year 2024-25 is approximately **₹5.94 lakh crore**.
 
• The total Union Budget for the Financial Year 2024-25 is estimated to be around **₹45.03 lakh crore**.
 
• The Defence Budget constitutes about **13.04%** of the total Union Budget.
 
• India's Defence Budget includes expenditure on the Army, Navy, Air Force, and other defence organizations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Budget of India**

 
 
• The Union Budget is an annual financial statement presented by the Government of India.
 
• It outlines the estimated government revenues and expenditures for the upcoming financial year.
 
• The budget is presented by the Finance Minister in the Parliament of India.
 
• It is a crucial tool for implementing the economic policies of the government.
 
 
 
• **Components of Defence Budget**
 
 
• Revenue Expenditure: Includes salaries, maintenance of establishments, and operational expenses.
 
• Capital Expenditure: Covers acquisition of new equipment, modernization, and infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Comparative Defence Budgets**
 
 
• India is among the top five countries with the highest defence budgets globally.
 
• The defence budget is crucial for maintaining national security and modernizing the armed forces.
 
 
 
• **Fiscal Deficit**
 
 
• The fiscal deficit is the difference between the government's total expenditure and its total revenue (excluding borrowings).
 
• It is an important indicator of the financial health of a country.

questions.question: Which Scorpene-class submarine was the sixth and final one delivered to the Indian Navy under Project P-75?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The submarine Vagsheer was the sixth and final Scorpene-class submarine delivered to the Indian Navy under Project P-75.
 
• Earlier submarines included Vela, Vajra, Vagir, and others, but Vagsheer completed the series.
 
• Project P-75 is an initiative to induct advanced diesel-electric submarines enhancing India’s naval strength.
 
• Project P-75 involves building six Scorpene-class submarines known as the Kalvari-class.
 
• These subs have advanced stealth and combat capabilities.
 
• Vagsheer’s commissioning marks the completion of the P-75 submarine deliveries.
 
• The submarines are built in India in collaboration with French firm Naval Group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Scorpene-class subs are integral to India’s maritime security and defense preparedness.
 
• They can launch torpedoes and anti-ship missiles.
 
• Indigenous manufacturing boosts India’s defense autonomy.

questions.question: What is the name of the first-ever tri-services defence space exercise conducted by the Defence Space Agency?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Antariksha Abhyas 2024**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Antariksha Abhyas - 2024, the first-ever tri-services defence space exercise, was launched by Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) General Anil Chauhan on November 11, 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The exercise is being conducted by the **Defence Space Agency under the Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff and runs until November 13.**
 
• **Objective**: The exercise aims to enhance India's capability to secure space assets, protect against vulnerabilities, and integrate cutting-edge technologies to safeguard national strategic interests in space.
 
• **Focus**: The exercise will simulate growing threats to space-based assets and services, improving understanding of operational dependencies on space, and identifying vulnerabilities from potential disruptions in space services.
 
• **Participants**: The exercise involves personnel from the Army, Navy, Air Force, as well as specialists from the** Defence Cyber Agency, Defence Intelligence Agency, Strategic Forces Command, ISRO, and DRDO.**
 
• **Key message from CDS Gen Chauhan:** Emphasized the need to secure national interests in space, innovate, and develop advanced systems in collaboration with DRDO, ISRO, and academia to maintain space-based security.

questions.question: Where has the 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2025 taken place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2025 will take place off Chennai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA will be held from 28 March to 2 April 2025 off Chennai.**
 
• The exercise will be conducted in two phases: Harbour phase (28 to 30 March) and Sea phase (31 March to 2 April).
 
• The exercise will feature naval ships from both nations, including Russian Federation Naval Ships Pechanga, Rezkiy, and Aldar Tsydenzhapov, and Indian Naval Ships Rana and Kuthar.
 
• The exercise aims to enhance maritime cooperation, exchange best operational practices, and strengthen diplomatic ties between India and Russia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INDRA Exercise Background__

 __
 
• INDRA has been conducted since 2003 and epitomizes the long-term strategic relationship between the Indian and Russian Navies.
 
• The exercise has evolved into a symbol of maritime cooperation between both countries.
 
 
 
• Activities during the Harbour and Sea Phases__
 
 
• Harbour Phase includes SMEEs, reciprocal visits, sports fixtures, and pre-sail briefings.
 
• The Sea Phase features advanced naval drills, tactical manoeuvres, live weapon firings, anti-air operations, and helicopter cross-deck landings.

questions.question: Where is the 8th India-Kazakhstan Joint Military Exercise KAZIND-2024 being held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 8th edition of the India-Kazakhstan Joint Military Exercise, KAZIND-2024, began on September 30, 2024, at the Surya Foreign Training Node in Auli, Uttarakhand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The exercise will run until October 13, 2024, focusing on strengthening military cooperation between **India and Kazakhstan.**
 
• The Indian Armed Forces are represented by **120 personnel, primarily from the KUMAON Regiment**, alongside additional members from other branches, including the** Indian Air Force.**
 
• The Kazakh contingent mainly comprises personnel from the **Kazakhstan Land Forces and Airborne Assault Troopers**, highlighting their commitment to enhancing bilateral military relations.
 
• KAZIND has been conducted annually since its inception in **2016**, serving as a key platform for tactical knowledge sharing, improved coordination, and strengthened military ties.
 
• The joint exercises typically emphasize counter-terrorism strategies, peacekeeping efforts, and humanitarian assistance during natural disasters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The previous edition of KAZIND occurred in Otar, Kazakhstan, from October 30 to November 11, 2023, further solidifying the defense partnership between the two nations.
 
• Over the years, KAZIND has evolved into a vital exercise that enhances mutual trust and understanding, improving interoperability and coordination between the armed forces of India and Kazakhstan.
 
• The Ministry of Defence stated that KAZIND-2024 aims to continue fostering deep defense cooperation and understanding between the two countries.

questions.question: Where did the 31st edition of the Singapore India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX) 2024 begin in October 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 31st Singapore India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX) started on 23 October 2024 in Visakhapatnam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• SIMBEX 2024 includes two phases: the Harbour Phase (23-25 October) and the Sea Phase (28-29 October) in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The exercise will feature advanced naval drills, anti-submarine warfare, and tactical operations.
 
• SIMBEX is part of efforts to enhance the strategic partnership between India and Singapore, especially in maritime cooperation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• SIMBEX is an annual maritime exercise aimed at strengthening the defense ties between the Indian and Singaporean navies.
 
• The exercise includes complex maritime drills that enhance coordination and cooperation in various maritime domains.
 
• Republic of Singapore Navy Ship RSS Tenacious with embarked helicopter, arrived at Visakhapatnam on 23 October 24 for participating in SIMBEX2024.
 
• SIMBEX, which began as 'Exercise Lion King' in 1994, has since evolved into one of the most significant bilateral maritime collaborations between the Indian Navy and the Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN).

questions.question: Where did the 15th edition of the India-US joint Special Forces exercise, VAJRA PRAHAR, take place from November 2 to 22, 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Idaho, USA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Exercise Vajra Prahar 2024: A joint military exercise between India and the US, running from November 2 to 22 in Idaho.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The exercise aims to enhance combined capabilities for joint special forces operations, focusing on desert and semi-desert environments. It will help develop interoperability and share best practices between the** two nations' forces.**
 
• Each country will contribute** 45 personnel from their respective special forces units.**
 
• **The last iteration of this exercise occurred in December 2023 at Umroi, Meghalaya, India.**
 
• **The exercise will take place at the Orchard Combat Training Centre in Idaho.**
 
• The exercise is designed to foster camaraderie and bonhomie between the soldiers of both countries, strengthening military ties and operational effectiveness.

questions.question: With which country is India conducting the 4th edition of the joint military exercise HARIMAU SHAKTI in December 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Malaysia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 4th edition of the India-Malaysia Joint Military Exercise HARIMAU SHAKTI commenced on 2nd December 2024 at Bentong camp, Pahang district, Malaysia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Objective:** Enhance joint military capability for counter-insurgency operations in jungle terrain under Chapter VII of the UN Mandate.
 
• **Indian Contingent:** 78 personnel from the MAHAR Regiment.
 
• **Malaysian Contingent:** 123 personnel from The Royal Malaysian Regiment.
 
• **Last Edition:** Held in November 2023 at Umroi Cantonment, Meghalaya, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Phases:__ The exercise includes cross-training, tactical demonstrations, and simulated exercises like ambush, recce patrol, and anti-MT ambush.
 
• __Significance:__ Promotes interoperability, camaraderie, and defence cooperation between India and Malaysia.
 
• __Frequency:__ An annual exercise conducted alternately in India and Malaysia.

questions.question: What is the theme of the 15th edition of Asia’s biggest aero show, Aero India 2025?

options.text: The Runway to a Billion Opportunities

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Runway to a Billion Opportunities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 15th edition of **Aero India 2025**, Asia's largest aero show, will be held from **February 10 to February 14** at the Air Force Station, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka.
 
• The theme of the event is **"The Runway to a Billion Opportunities,"** focusing on accelerating indigenization and showcasing cutting-edge aerospace technologies.
 
• The event includes **air displays, static exhibitions**, and a showcase of military and aerospace platforms, attracting global and domestic participants.
 
• The India Pavilion will emphasize the **Make-in-India initiative**, demonstrating indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Business Days:** The first three days (February 10-12) are designated as business days for industry professionals and decision-makers.
 
• **Public Days:** February 13 and 14 are open to the general public, allowing them to witness dynamic aerobatic displays and technology demonstrations.
 
• **Global Participation:** The event attracts global CEOs, domestic PSU CMDs, private defence companies, and dignitaries from over 98 countries.
 
• **Aero India Legacy:** With 14 successful editions since 1996, Aero India has established itself as a premier global aerospace exhibition.
 
• **Previous Edition:** The last edition in 2023 saw participation from over **7 lakh visitors**, 809 exhibitors, and dignitaries from across the globe.
 
• **Significance:** Aero India serves as a unique platform for fostering partnerships between foreign and Indian firms, bolstering India’s aerospace and defence sectors.
